steps.name: Sample structure QC and low-depth sample assessment
steps.question: Do the 12 skin samples (6 AD lesional, 6 control) separate by condition on PCA/sample-distance structure, and how does the low-depth sample sample_01 (library size ~4x below median) behave relative to its group — is it an outlier warranting exclusion, or merely low-depth and retainable?
acceptance_criteria: Library size and number of detected genes reported per sample, with sample_01 highlighted against the group median
Blind VST computed on the full count matrix; PCA on top 500 variable genes and a sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap produced, colored by condition
Explicit stated decision on sample_01: kept or removed, with the PCA/distance evidence cited as the reason (not depth alone)
QC plots and per-sample metrics saved for the report

steps.name: Filter, normalize, and DESeq2 Wald differential expression with apeglm shrinkage
steps.question: Which of the 12000 genes are differentially expressed between AD lesional and control skin (contrast: condition, AD_lesional vs Control, Control as reference level), using DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization, Wald test, apeglm-shrunken log2 fold changes, and BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha=0.05?
acceptance_criteria: Genes pre-filtered to >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size) before modeling; number of genes entering the model reported
DESeq2 factor explicitly releveled with Control as reference; contrast named as condition_AD_lesional_vs_Control
Median-of-ratios size factors computed inside DESeq2, no pre-scaling of counts; sample_01 retained per T1S1 decision, its size factor and influence noted
Wald test run, apeglm shrinkage applied to log2FC, results filtered at padj < 0.05 with independent filtering on and alpha=0.05 passed to results()
Count-outlier NA flags (Cook's distance) reported separately from independent-filtering NAs
Full results table (gene, baseMean, unshrunken and shrunken log2FC, pvalue, padj) exported; number of significant DE genes reported

steps.name: edgeR quasi-likelihood robustness check
steps.question: Do the DE genes called by an independent edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same 12000-gene counts and same AD_lesional-vs-Control design agree with the DESeq2 Wald results?
acceptance_criteria: Same pre-filtered gene set and design (condition, Control as reference) as T1S2, TMM normalization applied
edgeR glmQLFit + glmQLFTest run for AD_lesional vs Control; results at FDR < 0.05 reported
Overlap (intersection) between DESeq2 and edgeR significant gene sets reported as the high-confidence set; method-specific genes listed separately
Overlap counts and a brief concordance summary exported for the report

steps.name: Preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB Hallmark pathways are enriched (up or down) in AD lesional vs control skin, ranking all tested genes by the DESeq2 Wald statistic?
acceptance_criteria: Confirms availability of a human MSigDB Hallmark gene set collection in the environment before running; if absent, reports the gap explicitly rather than fabricating pathway results
All genes that passed the pre-filter (universe = tested genes) ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column); ranking statistic choice stated explicitly
fgsea run with gene set size window 15-500; BH-adjusted p-values reported
Redundant/overlapping significant Hallmark sets collapsed to representative sets per rule; full table kept as supplement
NES, padj, and leading-edge genes reported per significant Hallmark pathway
Report states enrichment result is dependent on method/ranking statistic choice, per known enrichment-method disagreement

steps.name: Consolidated DE and pathway report
steps.question: What is the complete, reproducible summary of QC decisions, differentially expressed genes, and Hallmark pathway changes between AD lesional and control skin?
acceptance_criteria: Reports method names and package versions (DESeq2, edgeR, fgsea, apeglm), the design formula, the named contrast (AD_lesional vs Control), and all thresholds (padj<0.05, gene set window 15-500)
States the sample_01 low-depth handling decision and its justification
Reports number of genes tested, number of DE genes (DESeq2 alone, edgeR alone, and intersection), and number of significant Hallmark pathways
Reports the gene set database and version, ranking metric, universe, and size window used for enrichment
States explicitly that the DE and enrichment results are exploratory/hypothesis-generating given the two-tool and single-ranking-statistic dependence

plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE + Hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 AD lesional, 6 control skin) are analyzed with DESeq2, the consensus tool for a 6-vs-6 unpaired, single-batch design with 2-11 replicates per group. Sample sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median; per the low-depth-sample rule it is kept through sample structure QC (PCA, sample distance heatmap, library size/detected-gene comparison) and its removal, if any, is a stated judgment call made after inspecting whether it is also an outlier on PCA/distances, not a default action based on depth alone. Counts are minimally pre-filtered (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smaller group size), then modeled with DESeq2's Wald test on an explicit reference-level factor (Control as reference, AD_lesional as numerator), with apeglm shrinkage of log2 fold changes and BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha=0.05. An edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test runs on the same counts/design as a robustness check; the overlap of the two gene sets is the high-confidence DE list, and method-specific genes are reported separately. Enrichment uses fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark gene sets (human), with the min/max gene-set size window (15-500) and redundancy collapsing, reported alongside the caveat that enrichment results are method- and ranking-statistic-dependent. A final report step consolidates QC, DE results, and pathway results with full method/version/threshold reporting for reproducibility.
